title: RoCE (RDMA over Converged Ethernet) v2
summary: RoCE v2 encapsulates InfiniBand transport (BTH) over UDP/IP/Ethernet. The packet: Ethernet header, IP header, UDP header (port 4791), then BTH, then payload. RoCE v2 uses standard IP routing, unlike RoCE v1 which uses Ethernet (not routable).

ext.summary: RoCE v2 encapsulates InfiniBand transport (BTH) over UDP/IP/Ethernet. The packet: Ethernet header, IP header, UDP header (port 4791), then BTH, then payload. RoCE v2 uses standard IP routing, unlike RoCE v1 which uses Ethernet (not routable).

structure.meaning: Dst MAC, Src MAC, EtherType 0x0800 (IPv4) or 0x86DD (IPv6).
Src port (ephemeral), Dst port 4791, length, checksum.

ext.example_hex: ff ff ff ff ff ff 00 00 00 00 00 00 08 00
ext.example_decoded: RoCE v2: Ethernet header with EtherType 0x0800 (IPv4)
notes: RoCE v2 is routable (unlike RoCE v1 which is Ethernet-only).
RoCE requires lossless Ethernet (PFC, ECN) for reliable transport.
RoCE is used by cloud providers (AWS EFA, Azure, GCP) for high-performance networking.
